name: Sarab
desc:
SARAB is inspired by real events, with some fictional elements added to make the experience more exciting and suspenseful.

Abu Abdullah asks you to help his son after his condition mysteriously changes.

But every clue you find leads to something more dangerous... and the closer you get to the truth, the harder it becomes to turn back.

Face challenging puzzles, intense chases, and strange creatures as you uncover the truth for yourselves.

🎮 1–4 Players  
📱 Available on Mobile, PC, and Console  
🔀 Features 3 Different Endings

**سراب | SARAB Horror**
